mapper.select: SELECT noticeboard_number AS noticeBoardNumber, board_type AS boardType, board_title AS boardTitle, board_content AS boardContent, board_click AS boardClick, DATE_FORMAT(board_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS boardDate, admin_number AS adminNumber, contest_number AS contestNumber, file_number AS fileNumber FROM UB_NOTICEBOARD WHERE noticeboard_number = #{noticeBoardNumber}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY noticeboard_number DESC) AS rn, noticeboard_number AS noticeBoardNumber, board_type AS boardType, board_title AS boardTitle, board_content AS boardContent, board_click AS boardClick, DATE_FORMAT(board_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS boardDate, admin_number AS adminNumber, contest_number AS contestNumber, file_number AS fileNumber FROM UB_NOTICEBOARD ) paged WHERE rn BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}

SELECT noticeboard_number AS noticeBoardNumber, board_type AS boardType, board_title AS boardTitle, board_content AS boardContent, board_click AS boardClick, DATE_FORMAT(board_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS boardDate, admin_number AS adminNumber, contest_number AS contestNumber, file_number AS fileNumber FROM UB_NOTICEBOARD WHERE contest_number = #{contestNumber} LIMIT 1
